klepton.label: MacLauncher Android

fields.label: Execution
fields.description: Android execution engine. Changes apply on the next launch.

fields.label: OpenGL ES backend
fields.description: Select ANGLE's graphics backend for the next launch. Vulkan uses the selected Vulkan implementation.

fields.label: Vulkan implementation
fields.description: Select an installed Vulkan implementation for Vulkan apps and ANGLE's Vulkan backend. Graphics → MoltenVK and KosmicKrisp in Runtimes manage downloads.

fields.label: Manual tilt
fields.description: Provide virtual motion sensors. Keyboard uses Q/E to tilt left/right and R to recenter; Option + arrow keys and Option + 0 are also available. Controller uses the right stick. No physical motion or location is collected.

fields.label: Keyboard touch joystick
fields.description: WASD controls a virtual touch joystick by default while the mouse operates a second touch, such as a boost button. Joystick mapping pauses during text editing; Command shortcuts retain normal keyboard input. Applies on the next launch.

fields.label: Joystick center X (%)
fields.description: Horizontal center, measured from the left of the Android display.

fields.label: Joystick center Y (%)
fields.description: Vertical center, measured from the top of the Android display.

fields.label: Joystick radius (%)
fields.description: Drag distance as a percentage of the shorter Android display dimension. Diagonal movement keeps the same distance.

fields.label: Allow ads
fields.description: Allow connections to known advertising hosts, including rewarded ads. Off by default. Applies on the next launch; game settings can override the Android default. External web links always require confirmation.

fields.label: Use microG
fields.description: Enable installed Google services for this game without signing in. Restart to apply.

fields.label: microG account
fields.description: Use microG anonymously or with a shared account from Settings → Android. Restart to apply.

klepton.preparation: Play downloads a needed runtime after confirmation.
klepton.dataNotice: Each runtime keeps separate game data; switching preserves it.

aim.label: AIM
aim.description: Original Android 16 with a Pixel Tablet display: 2560 × 1600 at 320 dpi.
aim.requirements: Apple Silicon · macOS 26.0 or later · 1.95 GB system image
aim.preparation: Play downloads needed runtimes and a 1.95 GB system image after confirmation. Applications run offline without Google account integration.
aim.dataNotice: Each runtime keeps separate game data; switching preserves it.

actions.label: Add to Google Play library
actions.confirm: Request a free Google Play license for this package using the Google account selected in game Settings? No paid purchase will be made.

actionGroups.label: APK tools
actionGroups.note: JADX exports Java source; Apktool exports smali and decoded resources. Original packages are preserved.

fields.label: Extra runtime options
fields.description: One option per line.

fields.label: Environment
fields.description: An existing bottle or wrapper is used in place. Settings and translator files can be changed; its environment is never recreated.

fields.label: Default Direct3D engine
fields.description: Sets the renderer for Direct3D versions without an override.

fields.label: Direct3D 8
fields.description: Chooses the installed translator for Direct3D 8. Shared libraries can also update linked Direct3D choices.

fields.label: Direct3D 9
fields.description: Chooses the installed translator for Direct3D 9. Shared libraries can also update linked Direct3D choices.

fields.label: Direct3D 10 / 10.1
fields.description: Chooses the installed translator for Direct3D 10 / 10.1. Shared libraries can also update linked Direct3D choices.

fields.label: Direct3D 11
fields.description: Chooses the installed translator for Direct3D 11. Shared libraries can also update linked Direct3D choices.

fields.label: Direct3D 12
fields.description: Chooses the installed translator for Direct3D 12. Shared libraries can also update linked Direct3D choices.

fields.label: Vulkan driver
fields.description: Chooses the Vulkan driver used by translators that render through Vulkan.

fields.label: Video codecs
fields.description: Adds codec plugins to the runtime’s video support.

fields.label: Graphics
fields.description: Only renderers compatible with the selected CrossOver version, Mac and macOS version are offered.

fields.label: Language locale
fields.description: Optional locale identifier, such as ja_JP.UTF-8 or en_US.UTF-8.

fields.label: Windows environment
fields.description: Changing this option uses a separate Windows environment. Existing saves remain in the previous environment.

fields.label: Windows executable (optional)
fields.description: Relative path inside the game folder. Automatic selects the game's executable.

fields.label: Game arguments
fields.description: One argument per line.

fields.label: DPI
fields.description: Positive DPI; empty uses the runtime default.

fields.label: Virtual desktop
fields.description: WIDTHxHEIGHT, such as 1920x1080; off disables the desktop; empty uses the runtime default.

fields.label: DXMT support
fields.description: Matching DXMT libraries for temporal upscaling. Automatic uses the Runtimes default.

fields.label: Wine DLL overrides
fields.description: One library=order entry per line, such as winhttp=n,b.

fields.label: WineD3D options
fields.description: Comma-separated WineD3D options, such as csmt=0x1,renderer=gl.

fields.label: Wine debug channels (optional)
fields.description: Wine channel filters, such as -all or +seh.

fields.label: Game temporal integration
fields.description: Expose the game's DLSS option. With DXMT or D3DMetal, MetalFX Temporal performs it; this requires Apple Silicon and DXMT on macOS 14 or later, or D3DMetal on macOS 26 or later, with matching NVAPI/NGX libraries. With DXVK or vkd3d-proton and a selected Vulkan driver build with a temporal carrier, a 64-bit Windows game's DLSS inputs always go through DXVK-NVAPI and the NGX core to that driver, independent of this setting; Play offers both libraries after consent. A shared temporal upscaler, or a DXMT or D3DMetal version from Runtimes selected for Direct3D 11 or 12, also enables this integration automatically. DLSS must be enabled in the game settings. Changes apply on the next launch.

fields.label: Game temporal integration
fields.description: Expose the game's DLSS option. With DXMT or D3DMetal, MetalFX Temporal performs it; this requires Apple Silicon and DXMT on macOS 14 or later, or D3DMetal on macOS 26.4 or later, with matching NVAPI/NGX libraries. With DXVK or vkd3d-proton and a selected Vulkan driver build with a temporal carrier, a 64-bit Windows game's DLSS inputs always go through DXVK-NVAPI and the NGX core to that driver, independent of this setting; Play offers both libraries after consent. A shared temporal upscaler, or a DXMT or D3DMetal version from Runtimes selected for Direct3D 11 or 12, also enables this integration automatically. DLSS must be enabled in the game settings. Changes apply on the next launch.

graphics-models.label: Lossless Scaling

components.label: Apple MetalFX
components.description: Spatial scaling uses the shared image. Temporal scaling and interpolation need scene inputs; denoised scaling also needs noisy color and material inputs. Spatial scaling: GPU supported. Temporal scaling: GPU supported. Denoised scaling: GPU supported. Frame interpolation: GPU supported.
components.requirements: Provided by macOS; no download. Spatial and temporal scaling require macOS 13.0 or later; denoised scaling and interpolation require macOS 26.0 or later. Available methods also depend on the included graphics processor and supplied inputs.

components.label: AMD FSR 1
components.description: Spatial EASU upscaling and RCAS sharpening use the current game image.
components.requirements: Included with MacLauncher on macOS 13.0 or later. No models or separate download.

components.label: AMD FSR 2.2
components.description: Native Metal temporal upscaling and RCAS sharpening.
components.requirements: macOS 13.0 or later. Requires renderer-provided depth, motion vectors, jitter and camera projection data. No model download.

components.label: AMD FSR 3.1
components.description: Native Metal temporal upscaling and RCAS sharpening.
components.requirements: macOS 13.0 or later. Requires renderer-provided depth, motion vectors, jitter and camera projection data. No model download.

components.label: AMD FSR 4.1
components.description: Native Metal neural temporal upscaling. The compatible model is included.
components.requirements: macOS 15.0 or later and an Apple Silicon GPU, for ARM and Intel game processes. Requires renderer-provided depth, motion vectors and camera jitter.

components.label: Intel XeSS
components.description: Included macOS GPU adapter for XeSS super resolution and frame generation. Original Intel runtime files are managed separately.
components.requirements: The adapter follows the MacLauncher graphics package version. Its declared Intel SDK dependency and a compatible GPU compute host are required.

components.label: Lossless Scaling
components.description: Two model families with separate availability: LS1 spatial upscaling and LSFG frame generation. Both use compatible models from a purchased copy.
components.requirements: Steam ownership is required. Download with Steam, find an existing installation or import a DLL below.

graphics-models.componentsDescription: Included components follow MacLauncher updates; MetalFX follows macOS updates. Available game options depend on the renderer and the inputs it provides.
graphics-models.description: Lossless Scaling provides LS1 spatial upscaling and LSFG frame generation models. They can be downloaded through Steam, found in an existing installation or imported from a DLL. An account that owns Lossless Scaling is required.

setupActions.label: Installed copies
setupActions.description: Find and import compatible DLLs in standard Steam libraries, Steam console downloads and CrossOver bottles. No network access.

setupActions.label: Steam download
setupActions.description: Downloads SteamCMD from Valve and opens Terminal for Steam sign-in and Steam Guard, separately from the Steam desktop app. An account that owns Lossless Scaling is required. Rosetta may be installed after consent. Compatible models are imported automatically; temporary downloads and sign-in files are removed. CrossOver and the Steam desktop app are not required.

catalog.importDescription: Copy compatible models from an installed Lossless Scaling DLL. The original file remains unchanged. Graphics methods depend on the active renderer.

setupActions.label: DLSSMac 0.1.6 · HT71 neural rendering model
setupActions.purpose: Reconstructs detail at the processing size, with optional history from real images.
setupActions.description: Reconstructs detail at the processing size, with optional history from real images. Downloads the release ZIP, verifies its checksum and imports only compatible model packages and notices. The application is not installed or executed. Temporary download files are removed. Converted NVIDIA model weights remain NVIDIA material and are not covered by the application's Apache-2.0 source license. Accompanying source notices are retained.

setupActions.purpose: Upscales an image with a trained model at its intrinsic output scale.
setupActions.description: Upscales an image with a trained model at its intrinsic output scale. Downloads pinned trained weights and notices, adapts their tensor names, and imports a shared model package. Model image processing runs on the GPU. Real-ESRGAN trained weights: BSD-3-Clause. Swift checkpoint conversion: MIT. Original notices are retained.

components.label: Store download helpers
components.description: Heroic's gogdl downloads GOG games, and Legendary downloads Epic Games Store games. A helper is downloaded with the first store download that needs it.

components.label: Steam game versions
components.description: The lists of game versions that the Steam window reads from Steam for each signed-in account. The window reads a deleted list again when it needs it.

components.label: Android system image
components.description: The original Android system image that AIM attaches read-only for Android games. Each game's writable data stays separate.

components.label: microG Services and Companion
components.description: The official microG packages that provide the shared Google account service to Android games.

components.label: Android store catalogs
components.description: The package indexes of F-Droid and IzzyOnDroid that the Android store window searches. The window reads a deleted index again when it needs it.

components.label: UmePlus Gothic fallback font
components.description: The fallback Japanese font for NScripter games that ship no default.ttf and have no font set in settings.

components.label: GMGSx MIDI soundfont
components.description: The General MIDI soundfont that MKXP-Z plays MIDI music with when no soundfont path is set in MKXP-Z settings.

components.label: RPG Maker XP RTP
components.description: The publisher's RPG Maker XP RTP 1.04, extracted once and shared by MKXP-Z games that declare it. The publisher's RTP terms apply.

components.label: RPG Maker VX RTP
components.description: The publisher's RPG Maker VX RTP 1.02, extracted once and shared by MKXP-Z games that declare it. The publisher's RTP terms apply.

components.label: RPG Maker VX Ace RTP
components.description: The publisher's RPG Maker VX Ace RTP 1.00, extracted once and shared by MKXP-Z games that declare it. The publisher's RTP terms apply.

components.label: Neural model source archives
components.description: Publisher archives kept after a neural model was extracted from them, so another model from the same archive needs no second download.

components.label: Shared runtime libraries
components.description: Libraries that several MacLauncher Builds packages load. Each is downloaded with the first runtime that needs it and is removed with the last one.

components.label: Translator descriptions
